paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: Paper presents first search for bosonic super-WIMPs (axion-like particles and dark photons) with GERDA using HPGe detectors. The abstract explicitly states the most stringent direct limits on g_ae < 3·10^-12 at 150 keV/c^2 at 90% credible interval. Data points extracted from Figure 3 (top panel) showing upper limits on g_ae across the mass range 60 keV/c^2 to 1 MeV/c^2. The paper also constrains dark photons via α'/α (DarkPhoton coupling type), but the primary new result emphasized in abstract and text is the AxionElectron coupling. Local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm^3 is explicitly stated as assumption for the search. Confidence is high due to clear identification of coupling type in abstract and explicit numerical example at 150 keV/c^2. | selector: text (sole candidate)
